summary: Military jets, including fast jets, carrying out high-energy manoeuvres within 5 nautical miles of disused Sculthorpe, up to 1,900 ft above sea level.
text:
EXER . MULTI MIL ACFT, INCLUDING FAST JETS, WILL CONDUCT HIGH
ENERGY MANOEVRES WI 5NM RADIUS OF 525051N 0004546E (SCULTHORPE
DISUSED). ACFT MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO MONITOR
FREQ 128.900MHZ OR FREQ 275.825MHZ OR CTC 01638 544807 / 01638
542073. AR-2026-11002/01.
